title: SeaTalk bridge
description: SeaTalk 1 to Signal K bridge: bus timing and, per datagram type, direction and send period.

keys.name: idle_us
keys.title: Quiet bus before sending
keys.description: How long the bus must be quiet before this device sends, in microseconds (shown in ms). The ST50 waits about 26 ms; do not go below 24 ms.

keys.name: jitter_us
keys.title: Random extra wait
keys.description: A random 0 to this many microseconds (shown in ms) is added to the quiet-bus wait, so two devices do not start together.

keys.name: stale_ms
keys.title: Value timeout
keys.description: A Signal K value older than this is not sent to the bus; the display goes blank instead of showing an old number.

keys.name: mag_fallback
keys.title: Magnetic from true
keys.description: When no fresh headingMagnetic or courseOverGroundMagnetic arrives, compute it from the true value minus navigation.magneticVariation.

keys.name: m_00
keys.title: Mode
keys.description: off = nothing in either direction. to_sk = bus to Signal K only. to_bus = Signal K to bus only. both = both directions, no check for another device on the bus. auto = bus to Signal K always; Signal K to bus only while no other bus device has sent this type in the last 10 s.

keys.name: p_00
keys.title: Send period
keys.description: How often this datagram is sent to the bus. 0 = never sent.
